sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and purpose
sections.what: Brings in the database client, the rights check, the event shape and the incident save step. The file states that rights are checked before anything is stored.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps sources that are not allowed out of storage.

sections.name: ingestEvent
sections.title: Saving one event
sections.what: Checks the source may be stored, then creates or finds the competition, season, event and teams, links the teams to the event, and saves the incidents. Returns the event ID and how many incidents were added.
sections.why: Likely reason: upserts let the same event be loaded again without making duplicate event records.
sections.watch_out: Existing competitions, events and teams are not updated on reload, so a corrected name or date will not reach the store.

summary: Saves a parsed match and its incidents into the store, after a rights check.
purpose: The path from a parsed event to stored records.
why: Likely reason: upserts let the same event be loaded again without duplicating the event record.
how: 1. Check the source may be stored. 2. Create or find the competition, season and event. 3. Create or find each team and link it to the event. 4. Save the event's incidents.
outputs: The event ID and the number of incidents added.
risks: Names and dates are not updated when an event is loaded again. Duplicate incidents depend on the save step, which is not shown.
debug: If loading is refused, check the rights policy for the source. If incident counts double, check the save step.
